findings.source_quote: By the time we got into a room, Judy had finally stopped seizing. As she lay on the stretcher, semi-comatose, she went into a second, milder seizure.

The translation uses ניידת (vehicle) where the source means 'stretcher' (אלונקה). This changes the meaning and is a substantive error. Replace the word with the correct Hebrew term and retain the rest of the sentence. Example fix inside the same
